posts.author: bernardb
posts.content_md:
Hi All, 

I remember reading somewhere (here?) about using Edmund -FL lenses for diverging the beam.

I am looking at these lenses and the only apparent difference is the coating.

Any advice on what coating is best, or info coating at all.

Edmund: NT32-988, Glass SF11

12mm Diameter, -12mm FL, Coating: None

Edmund: NT32-989, Glass SF1

12mm Diameter, -12mm FL, Coating: 1/4 wave MgF2 @ 550nm

Edmund: NT45-928, Glass SF1

12mm Diameter, -12mm FL, Coating: VIS-NIR

Thanks for the help as always.

Bernard

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: I get the VIS-NIR from them. I find it is durable and works well. I still have to tilt all flat surfaces off axis a little to stop back reflections from entering the laser.
